views.name: customer_transaction_normalized
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  row_number() OVER (ORDER BY txn_date, customer_id, txn_amount, txn_type) AS txn_id,
  date(txn_date) AS txn_date,
  txn_amount,
  txn_type,
  CASE
    WHEN lower(txn_type) IN ('deposit') THEN txn_amount
    WHEN lower(txn_type) IN ('withdrawal') THEN -txn_amount
    ELSE txn_amount
  END AS signed_amount,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', date(txn_date)) AS INTEGER) AS year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', date(txn_date)) AS INTEGER) AS month,
  date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(txn_date))) AS month_start_date,
  date(date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(txn_date)), '+1 month', '-1 day')) AS month_end_date
FROM customer_transactions
views.description: One normalized transaction row per customer transaction with parsed dates, canonical txn_type mapping to signed_amount, and month/year and month_start/month_end derived fields.

views.name: customer_monthly_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ct.customer_id,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS month,
  date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', ct.txn_date)) AS month_start_date,
  date(date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', ct.txn_date)), '+1 month', '-1 day') AS month_end_date,
  SUM(ct.txn_amount * CASE WHEN ct.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS monthly_txn_sum,
  COUNT(*) AS month_txn_count
FROM customer_transactions ct
GROUP BY ct.customer_id, year, month
views.description: Monthly aggregated measures per customer-month: sum of signed amounts for transactions within that month and the month date bounds. One row per customer per calendar month that has at least one transaction.

views.name: customer_month_series_bounds
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  MIN(txn_date) AS min_txn_date,
  MAX(txn_date) AS max_txn_date,
  strftime('%Y', MIN(txn_date)) AS start_year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', MIN(txn_date)) AS INTEGER) AS start_month,
  strftime('%Y', MAX(txn_date)) AS end_year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', MAX(txn_date)) AS INTEGER) AS end_month,
  date(substr(MIN(txn_date),1,7) || '-01') AS start_month_date,
  date(substr(MAX(txn_date),1,7) || '-01', '+1 month', '-1 day') AS end_month_date
FROM customer_transactions
GROUP BY customer_id
views.description: For each customer, the earliest and latest transaction dates (and corresponding month/year) defining the inclusive month range to produce months for; one row per customer.
counter_examples: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages

views.name: customer_2020_transaction_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  txn_date,
  txn_type,
  txn_amount
FROM customer_transactions
WHERE txn_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
views.description: All customer_transactions rows whose txn_date is within the year 2020. This selects the relevant time window but does not aggregate; keeps original txn_type and txn_amount.

views.name: customer_monthly_txn_sums
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS year,
  strftime('%m', txn_date) AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sum_deposits,
  SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sum_withdrawals,
  SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
FROM customer_transactions
GROUP BY customer_id, year, month
views.description: Per customer and calendar month (year and month), compute sums of txn_amount for deposits and withdrawals during that month and the net month-end balance (deposits minus withdrawals). Uses only txn rows (filtering to 2020 is applied upstream or can be applied here). Produces one row per customer_id, year, month.

views.name: customer_month_population
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cts.customer_id AS customer_id,
  2020 AS year,
  m.month AS month,
  COALESCE(s.monthly_txn_sum, 0) AS month_end_balance
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions) cts
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT 1 AS month UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12) m
LEFT JOIN
  (
    SELECT
      customer_id,
      CAST(strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
      CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS month,
      SUM(txn_amount) AS monthly_txn_sum
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, year, month
  ) s
  ON s.customer_id = cts.customer_id
  AND s.year = 2020
  AND s.month = m.month
WHERE 1=1
views.description: All combinations of each customer and each calendar month in 2020 (one row per customer_id, year, month). Left-join the monthly txn sums so that months with no transactions produce zero month_end_balance. This yields the canonical month-level balance per customer including zeros.
